title: Proposal to Review Built Environment Code to Enable Building of More Lactation Rooms
what_it_is: Proposal to Review Built Environment Code to Enable Building of More Lactation Rooms

sections.label: Expanded lactation room requirement
sections.summary: The new Code expands the requirement to provide at least one lactation room to more building types, including hospitals, polyclinics and some mixed-use developments.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Under the new Code which took effect in January this year, the requirement to provide at least one lactation room has been expanded to apply to more building types.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Besides offices and business parks with a gross floor area (GFA) of 10,000 square metres (sqm) or more, this requirement now also applies to all hospitals and polyclinics, as well as mixed-use developments where the non-residential component has a GFA of 10,000 sqm or more.

sections.label: BCA Accessibility Fund grants
sections.summary: BCA's Accessibility Fund is worth about $39.2 million and can cover up to 60% of construction cost for accessibility features, capped at $300,000 per development.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: On the Member's question on grants, BCA has an Accessibility Fund (AF) worth about $39.2 million in which we incentivise building owners to undertake voluntary upgrading.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Up to 60% of the construction cost for accessibility features, such as lactation rooms, can be used up to a cap of $300,000 per development.

sections.label: Timing of Building Code study
sections.summary: Building Codes are typically studied every few years, but no date is set for the next study.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Our Building Codes are typically studied every few years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: I do not have a date for the next study, so I am not going to commit at this point.

sections.label: Difficulty of fixing demand
sections.summary: Fixing demand is hard because it depends on worker profile, so regulating provision is difficult and impractical, though more can be done without waiting for a review.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: In this case, it is very hard to fix a demand because it depends on the profile of the workers too, whether you have an older workforce or a very young workforce.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: So, it is difficult and impractical as well to fix a Code and regulate that everyone has to provide this because it also depends on the demand as well.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: To some extent, we will study this and certainly survey and study more but without waiting for a review, we can certainly do more, such as encouraging organisations to support this.
